user.title: DockMon
user.description: Connect to your DockMon instance to monitor and control Docker containers.

data_description.url: Base address of your DockMon instance, scheme included, and the port if it is not the default one.
data_description.api_key: API key with read+write permissions, from DockMon Settings → API Keys.
data_description.verify_ssl: Turn this off only if DockMon uses a self-signed certificate. Leaving it on protects the API key in transit.

reauth_confirm.title: Reauthenticate DockMon
reauth_confirm.description: The API key for {url} was rejected. Enter a new one from DockMon Settings → API Keys.

error.cannot_connect: Unable to connect to DockMon. Check the address.
error.invalid_certificate: The SSL certificate could not be verified. Turn off certificate verification if DockMon uses a self-signed certificate.

abort.already_configured: This DockMon instance is already configured.
